report: Freshly inspected the current complete claim, service_spec.rs implementation context, complete associated test and association inventory, and captured current architectural rationale, review deferral policy and module-completeness interfaces. The claim has four obligations: phase incompleteness is terminal; complete results are distinguishable from conservative results; that distinction covers user errors, unsupported functionality, unavailable facts and explicit resource bounds; and these limited results are never presented as merely needing more scheduling. The referenced rationale additionally explains retained partial information, absent completeness guarantees, separation from logical negative answers and stability until inputs, environment or limits change. All remain deferred at pipeline scope. The sole implementation entry is explicitly TODO and identifies the missing uniform terminal completeness result for module expansion. Current source context shows method-provider and symbol-listing completeness returning consumer-specific booleans, including false for error and unsupported expansion cases; this supports retaining the stated uniform-interface deferral, without asserting that those partial APIs establish the entire pipeline claim. No ordinary implementation association claims completion, and no N/A entries exist. The sole associated test, sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_ir_crate_terminal_incompleteness, is an assertion-free TODO. Its comment specifies checking each incomplete phase's reason and surviving guarantees and repeating unchanged demands to prevent silent upgrades to complete. It supplies a deferred verification plan, not passing behavioral evidence. Its prerequisite is the uniform terminal-result publication explicitly missing in the implementation TODO; after that exists, fixtures must cover each of the four limitation causes and repeated demand with unchanged inputs and limits, asserting conservative usable facts and that incompleteness is neither pending work nor a definitive negative answer. These explicit implementation and test deferrals adequately account for every obligation without representing functionality as implemented. No new suspected behavioral violation was identified beyond the declared gap. Executed review start/read commands only for this source assessment; no behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer, and central execution remains root's responsibility. No source changes were made. This approval accepts honest TODO evidence only, not pipeline-wide implementation or test completeness.
